name: Aftermarket HQ
old_description: At Aftermarket HQ, we combine top-tier craftsmanship, cutting-edge technology, and real-world expertise to deliver vehicles that perform as hard as you do. Whether it’s suspension systems, custom fabrication, or complete off-road builds, our work speaks for itself — built by enthusiasts, for enthusiasts.
about:
Aftermarket HQ operates from Las Vegas, Nevada, where it has served the off-road community for over a decade. The shop describes itself as built by enthusiasts for enthusiasts, though the INPUT does not specify an exact founding year or ownership structure. Team members referenced in customer testimonials include Walt, Evan, Vanessa, and Jamie.

The shop provides suspension systems, custom fabrication, and complete off-road builds, along with installation, tuning, and parts sales. Fabrication work includes CNC-machined billet aluminum components such as Starlink mounts, 16-gauge steel brackets with matte fine-textured black powder coating, and 304 stainless steel downpipes. Services extend to ECU flashing, wiring harness integration, and LED lighting installation from brands such as Baja Designs and SwarfWorks. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not disclosed.

Customers are primarily off-road enthusiasts driving Ford F-150, Raptor, Super Duty, Bronco, and Ranger platforms. The shop supports desert racing, rock crawling, and trail riding applications, supplying both individual owners and builders seeking turnkey upgrades or à la carte performance parts.

Aftermarket HQ emphasizes that every product is tested in the desert, on rocks, and through trails before it reaches the customer. The founders started the business to combine real-world driving experience with fabrication capability, positioning the shop as a community hub where enthusiasts can source parts, tuning, and full builds from a team that uses the same equipment they sell.
